features: Analog Turbo HD (TVI) camera — HD-over-coax to a Turbo HD DVR; not an IP camera
IR supplement light, up to 40 m
PoC (power over coax) — power and HD video on one coaxial cable
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE56D0T-VFIR3E is a 2 MP analog Turbo HD (TVI) PoC manual-varifocal turret camera (2.8-12 mm) with IR up to 40 m and an IP67 housing, carrying power and HD video on one coaxial cable. It is an HD-over-coax camera for a Turbo HD DVR, not an IP camera. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE56D0T-VFIR3E).
